pages.text: Time ages glass to sand. Only a vial lined with $(item)phantom membrane$() holds it, and even that weeps: a filled $(item)Stasis Ampoule$() leaks if carried too long.$(br2)Fit the amethyst needle and carry an ampoule; the syringe draws Time straight into it.

Few creatures have time to spare: $(l)phantoms$(), $(l)endermen$(), the $(l)undead$(). A $(l)baby$() carries its future; take it and it grows up on the spot.$(br2)Take all of a creature's time and it crumbles, leaving $(item)Temporal Residue$().
